Recorded tachyarrhythmia excerpts · source and license notice

Contains information from the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database v1.0.0, made available
by George Moody and Roger Mark through PhysioNet under the Open Data Commons
Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By).
Dataset: https://physionet.org/content/mitdb/1.0.0/
DOI: https://doi.org/10.13026/C2F305
License: https://physionet.org/content/mitdb/view-license/1.0.0/
Original publication: Moody GB, Mark RG. The impact of the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia
Database. IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Magazine 20(3):45–50 (2001).
https://doi.org/10.1109/51.932724
Exported records: 202 (AF with measured RVR), 222 (atrial flutter), 209 (SVTA).

Contains information from the MIT-BIH Malignant Ventricular Ectopy Database
v1.0.0, made available by Paul Albrecht, George Moody and Roger Mark through
PhysioNet under the Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By).
Dataset: https://physionet.org/content/vfdb/1.0.0/
DOI: https://doi.org/10.13026/C22P44
License: https://physionet.org/content/vfdb/view-license/1.0.0/
Original publication: Greenwald SD. Development and analysis of a ventricular
fibrillation detector. MIT Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer
Science, M.S. thesis (1986). https://dspace.mit.edu/handle/1721.1/92988
Exported records: 421 (VT), 422 (VF).

These databases contain the source recordings and reference rhythm labels.
The exports retain native calibrated signal samples; the website's local
voltage/tissue activation/mechanics illustrations are separate teaching models.
Refer to clinical-tachyarrhythmias-README.md and the provenance JSON for crop
coordinates, source hashes, exact calibration, annotation status and limitations.
